answer: Every signal must register on a vertex of the funding graph, the node its bond money traces back to within three hops, and the k-th signal registered on one vertex burns 2^k haven. A thousand clones fed from one treasury would owe about 2^1000 haven, so the attacker must launder funds into a thousand unlinked sources, one vertex each, buying fresh outside capital and exchange accounts that cost more as clean ones run out. It breaks if mixers can hide funds within three hops.
